contract_name: Core V3 - Terminal Inventory Controlled Dynamic DAE Contract
decision: Authorize one separately frozen live zero-time residual and leading-Jacobian audit at the DD-169 root. Controller tuning, timestepping, and controlled trajectories remain unauthorized.

parameter_provenance.geometry: established C3/C4 workbook vessel geometry used by DD-123
parameter_provenance.qualification: structural validity only; no tuning acceptance

measurement_definition: Terminal liquid amount is converted to liquid volume with the live provider molar density. Top level uses a horizontal cylindrical vessel with two hemispherical heads; bottom level uses a vertical cylindrical sump. Both measurements are normalized level fractions.
controller_definition: At each terminal, dI/dt=(Kc/Ti)*(level-level_setpoint) and log(product/reference)=I+Kc*(level-level_setpoint). The positive product draw uses the live terminal liquid composition.
